030public class PlotUtils {
031
032    // --- Styling Constants ---
033    private static final int   MARGIN_LEFT   = 70;
034    private static final int   MARGIN_RIGHT  = 40;
035    private static final int   MARGIN_TOP    = 40;
036    private static final int   MARGIN_BOTTOM = 60;
037    private static final Color COLOR_DATA    = new Color(30, 100, 200);
038    private static final Color COLOR_FIT     = Color.RED;
039    private static final Color COLOR_AXES    = Color.GRAY;
040    private static final Color COLOR_SUCCESS = new Color(0, 128, 0);
041    private static final Font  FONT_LABEL    = new Font("SansSerif", Font.PLAIN, 12);
042
043    private PlotUtils() {
044        // Utility class — prevent instantiation
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * Renders a Tau plot with the given data points, the fitted curve (if available),
049     * axes, labels, and annotation text.
050     *
051     * @param x         the x-coordinates of the data points
052     * @param y         the y-coordinates of the data points
053     * @param result    the Tau-fit result, including Tau and R²
054     * @param fitFailed true if the exponential fit failed
055     * @param width     image width in pixels
056     * @param height    image height in pixels
057     * @return          a BufferedImage containing the rendered plot
058     */
059    public static BufferedImage renderTauPlot(double[] x,
060            double[]                        y,
061            CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult result,
062            boolean                         fitFailed,
063            int                             width,
064            int                             height) {
065
066        // --- Initialize blank image and 2D context ---
067        BufferedImage img = new BufferedImage(width, height, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
068        Graphics2D g2 = img.createGraphics();
069        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
070
071        // --- Draw background ---
072        g2.setColor(Color.WHITE);
073        g2.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
074
075        // --- Define margins and plotting area ---
076        int x0 = MARGIN_LEFT;
077        int y0 = height - MARGIN_BOTTOM;
078
079        // --- Determine axis ranges from data ---
080        double minX = Arrays.stream(x).min().orElse(0);
081        double maxX = Arrays.stream(x).max().orElse(1);
082        double minY = Arrays.stream(y).min().orElse(0);
083        double maxY = Arrays.stream(y).max().orElse(1);
084
085        // Add 5% padding on both axes so points stay within the frame
086        double padX = (maxX - minX) * 0.05;
087        double padY = (maxY - minY) * 0.05;
088        if (padX == 0) padX = 1.0;
089        if (padY == 0) padY = 1.0;
090
091        minX -= padX;
092        maxX += padX;
093        minY -= padY;
094        maxY += padY;
095
096        // --- Scaling factors ---
097        double xScale = (width - MARGIN_LEFT - MARGIN_RIGHT) / (maxX - minX);
098        double yScale = (height - MARGIN_TOP - MARGIN_BOTTOM) / (maxY - minY);
099
100        // --- Axes ---
101        g2.setColor(COLOR_AXES);
102        g2.drawLine(x0, y0, width - MARGIN_RIGHT, y0);
103        g2.drawLine(x0, y0, x0, MARGIN_TOP);
104
105        // --- Data points ---
106        g2.setColor(COLOR_DATA);
107        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
108            int px = (int) (MARGIN_LEFT + (x[i] - minX) * xScale);
109            int py = (int) (y0 - (y[i] - minY) * yScale);
110            g2.fillOval(px - 3, py - 3, 6, 6);
111        }
112
113        // --- Fitted exponential curve ---
114        if (!fitFailed && result != null && Double.isFinite(result.getTau())) {
115            double tau = result.getTau();
116            double t = (tau > 0) ? 1000.0 / tau : Double.NaN;
117
118            double m = Arrays.stream(y).max().orElse(1);
119            double b = Arrays.stream(y).min().orElse(0);
120            g2.setColor(COLOR_FIT);
121
122            int    steps = 200;
123            double prevX = minX;
124            double prevY = m * Math.exp(-t * prevX) + b;
125            for (int i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {
126
127                double cx = minX + (maxX - minX) * i / steps;
128                double cy = m * Math.exp(-t * cx) + b;
129                int    x1 = (int) (MARGIN_LEFT + (prevX - minX) * xScale);
130                int    y1 = (int) (y0 - (prevY - minY) * yScale);
131                int    x2 = (int) (MARGIN_LEFT + (cx - minX) * xScale);
132                int    y2 = (int) (y0 - (cy - minY) * yScale);
133
134                g2.drawLine(x1, y1, x2, y2);
135                prevX = cx;
136                prevY = cy;
137            }
138        }
139
140        // --- Axis labels ---
141        g2.setColor(Color.BLACK);
142        g2.setFont(FONT_LABEL);
143        g2.drawString("Duration", width / 2 - 30, height - 20);
144
145        g2.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
146        g2.drawString("Frequency", -height / 2 - 30, 20);
147        g2.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
148
149        // --- Fit annotation ---
150        g2.setColor(fitFailed ? Color.RED.darker() : COLOR_SUCCESS);
151        String msg = fitFailed
152                ? "Fit failed"
153                : String.format("Tau = %.1f ms, R² = %.3f", result.getTau(), result.getRSquared());
154        g2.drawString(msg, MARGIN_LEFT + 10, MARGIN_TOP + 20);
155
156        g2.dispose();
157        return img;
158    }
159
160    /**
161     * Exports a background-track histogram for each recording as a PNG file:
162     * <p>
163     *     Output/Background Plots/<recording>.png
164     * <p>
165     * @param experiment      the experiment containing the recordings
166     * @param experimentPath  the experiment root path
167     * @throws IOException    if image output fails
168     */
169    public static void exportBackgroundHistogramsToPngs(Experiment experiment, Path experimentPath) throws IOException {        Path outputDir = experimentPath.resolve("Output").resolve(BACKGROUND_PLOTS);
170        Files.createDirectories(outputDir);
171
172        for (Recording recording : experiment.getRecordings()) {
173            List<Square> squares = recording.getSquaresOfRecording();
174            if (squares == null || squares.isEmpty()) {
175                PaintLogger.debugf("Recording '%s': no squares%n", recording.getRecordingName());
176                continue;
177            }
178
179            SquareUtils.BackgroundEstimationResult backgroundResult          = calculateBackgroundDensity(squares);
180            Set<Square>                            backgroundSet             = new HashSet<>(backgroundResult.getBackgroundSquares());
181            double                                 backgroundTracksPerSquare = backgroundResult.getNumberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare();
182
183            int totalSquares          = squares.size();
184            int nBackground           = backgroundSet.size();
185            int totalTracks           = squares.stream().mapToInt(Square::getNumberOfTracks).sum();
186            int backgroundTracksTotal = backgroundSet.stream().mapToInt(Square::getNumberOfTracks).sum();
187
188            int maxTracks = squares.stream().mapToInt(Square::getNumberOfTracks).max().orElse(0);
189            int binSize   = Math.max(1, maxTracks / 20);
190            int binCount  = (maxTracks / binSize) + 1;
191
192            int[] allBins = new int[binCount];
193            int[] bgBins  = new int[binCount];
194
195            for (Square sq : squares) {
196                int n   = sq.getNumberOfTracks();
197                int bin = Math.min(n / binSize, binCount - 1);
198                allBins[bin]++;
199                if (backgroundSet.contains(sq)) {
200                    bgBins[bin]++;
201                }
202            }
203
204            int plotWidth  = 900;
205            int plotHeight = 600;
206            BufferedImage img = new BufferedImage(plotWidth, plotHeight, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
207            Graphics2D g2 = img.createGraphics();
208
209            // Draw histogram into the graphics context
210            drawHistogram(
211                    g2,
212                    plotWidth,
213                    plotHeight,
214                    allBins,
215                    bgBins,
216                    binSize,
217                    recording.getRecordingName(),
218                    totalSquares,
219                    totalTracks,
220                    nBackground,
221                    backgroundTracksTotal,
222                    backgroundTracksPerSquare
223            );
224            g2.dispose();
225
226            Path outFile = outputDir.resolve(recording.getRecordingName() + ".png");
227            ImageIO.write(img, "png", outFile.toFile());
228            PaintLogger.debugf("Wrote background histogram to %s%n", outFile);
229        }
230    }

236    /**
237     * Saves a Tau-fit plot (successful or failed) for the given square.
238     * Output is stored as:
239     *     Output/Tau-Fitting Plots/Success/&lt;name&gt;.png
240     *     Output/Tau-Fitting Plots/Failed/&lt;name&gt;.png
241     * <p>
242     * The output directory tree is created automatically.
243     * <p>
244     * @param tracks         the tracks used in Tau fitting
245     * @param tauResult      the Tau fitting result (may indicate failure)
246     * @param experimentPath the root path of the experiment
247     * @param recordingName  the recording name
248     * @param squareIndex    the square index (used in file naming)
249     */
250    public static void saveTauFitPlot(
251            List<Track> tracks,
252            CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult tauResult,
253            Path experimentPath,
254            String recordingName,
255            int squareIndex
256    ) {
257        boolean fitFailed =
258                (tauResult == null) ||
259                        (tauResult.getStatus() != CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult.Status.TAU_SUCCESS) ||
260                        !Double.isFinite(tauResult.getTau()) ||
261                        !Double.isFinite(tauResult.getRSquared());
262
263        // Build frequency distribution: duration → count
264        Map<Double, Integer> freqMap = new TreeMap<>();
265        for (Track track : tracks) {
266            double d = track.getTrackDuration();
267            freqMap.put(d, freqMap.getOrDefault(d, 0) + 1);
268        }
269
270        double[] x = new double[freqMap.size()];
271        double[] y = new double[freqMap.size()];
272        int idx = 0;
273        for (Map.Entry<Double, Integer> e : freqMap.entrySet()) {
274            x[idx] = e.getKey();
275            y[idx] = e.getValue();
276            idx++;
277        }
278
279        // Render plot
280        BufferedImage img = renderTauPlot(x, y, tauResult, fitFailed, 900, 600);
281
282        // Determine output directory
283        Path rootDir   = experimentPath.resolve("Output").resolve(TAU_FITTING_PLOTS);
284        Path targetDir = rootDir.resolve(fitFailed ? "Failed" : "Success");
285
286        try {
287            Files.createDirectories(targetDir);
288            Path plotPath = targetDir.resolve(
289                    String.format("%s_square_%03d.png", recordingName, squareIndex)
290            );
291            ImageIO.write(img, "png", plotPath.toFile());
292        } catch (Exception e) {
293            // Log failure without throwing
294            PaintLogger.errorf(
295                    "Failed to save Tau-fit plot for '%s' square %03d: %s",
296                    recordingName,
297                    squareIndex,
298                    e.getMessage()
299            );
300        }
301    }
302
303    // ========================================================================
304    // Histogram drawing helper
305    // ========================================================================
306
307    /**
308     * Draws a histogram into the given Graphics2D context. The histogram displays:
309     * <p>
310     *   • Track-count distribution across all squares
311     *   • Track-count distribution among "background" squares
312     *   • Summary statistics rendered as text in the upper-right corner
313     * <p>
314     * All layout calculations are pixel-accurate to ensure consistent rendering
315     * regardless of image size.
316     */
317    private static void drawHistogram(
318            Graphics2D g2,
319            int        w,
320            int        h,
321            int[]      allBins,
322            int[]      bgBins,
323            int        binSize,
324            String     title,
325            int        totalSquares,
326            int        totalTracks,
327            int        nBackground,
328            int        backgroundTracksTotal,
329            double     avgTracksInBackground
330    ) {
331        g2.setRenderingHint(
332                RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING,
333                RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON
334        );
335        g2.setColor(Color.WHITE);
336        g2.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
337
338        int marginLeft   = 70;
339        int marginBottom = 50;
340        int marginTop    = 50;
341        int marginRight  = 40;
342
343        int binCount    = allBins.length;
344        int maxBinCount = Arrays.stream(allBins).max().orElse(1);
345
346        double xStep  = (double)(w - marginLeft - marginRight) / binCount;
347        double yScale = (double)(h - marginTop - marginBottom) / maxBinCount;
348
349        // Axes
350        g2.setColor(Color.GRAY);
351        int x0 = marginLeft;
352        int y0 = h - marginBottom;
353        g2.drawLine(x0, y0, w - marginRight, y0);
354        g2.drawLine(x0, y0, x0, marginTop);
355
356        // Tick marks
357        g2.setColor(Color.BLACK);
358        int nTicks = 5;
359        for (int i = 0; i <= nTicks; i++) {
360            int y = y0 - (i * (h - marginTop - marginBottom) / nTicks);
361            int value = (int)Math.round(i * (double)maxBinCount / nTicks);
362            g2.drawLine(x0 - 5, y, x0, y);
363            g2.drawString(String.valueOf(value), x0 - 45, y + 5);
364        }
365
366        // Bars
367        for (int i = 0; i < binCount; i++) {
368            int total      = allBins[i];
369            int background = bgBins[i];
370            int x          = (int)(x0 + i * xStep);
371            int barW       = (int)(xStep * 0.8);
372
373            if (background > 0) {
374                int bgHeight = (int)(background * yScale);
375                int bgY      = y0 - bgHeight;
376                g2.setColor(new Color(100, 160, 255, 180));
377                g2.fillRect(x, bgY, barW, bgHeight);
378            }
379
380            int fgHeight = (int)((total - background) * yScale);
381            if (fgHeight > 0) {
382                int fgY = y0 - fgHeight - (int)(background * yScale);
383                g2.setColor(new Color(180, 180, 180));
384                g2.fillRect(x, fgY, barW, fgHeight);
385            }
386
387            g2.setColor(Color.BLACK);
388            g2.drawRect(x, y0 - (int)(total * yScale), barW, (int)(total * yScale));
389        }
390
391        // Labels
392        g2.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.PLAIN, 12));
393        g2.drawString(
394                "Track count bins (bin size ≈ " + binSize + ")",
395                w / 2 - 90,
396                h - 15
397        );
398        g2.drawString("Number of squares", 10, marginTop - 10);
399
400        g2.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.BOLD, 16));
401        g2.drawString(
402                "Track Count Histogram – " + title,
403                w / 2 - 150,
404                marginTop - 20
405        );
406
407        // Right-side summary panel
408        g2.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.BOLD, 14));
409        g2.setColor(new Color(0, 70, 180));
410
411        int textX = w - 400;
412        int textY = marginTop + 20;
413        int lineSpacing = 20;
414
415        String[] labels = new String[]{
416                "Number of squares in recording",
417                "Number of tracks in recording",
418                "Number of background squares",
419                "Number of tracks in background",
420                "Average number of tracks in the background"
421        };
422        String[] values = new String[]{
423                String.valueOf(totalSquares),
424                String.valueOf(totalTracks),
425                String.valueOf(nBackground),
426                String.valueOf(backgroundTracksTotal),
427                String.format("%.3f", avgTracksInBackground)
428        };
429
430        FontMetrics fm = g2.getFontMetrics();
431        int maxLabelW = 0;
432        for (String label : labels) {
433            maxLabelW = Math.max(maxLabelW, fm.stringWidth(label));
434        }
435
436        // Column positions
437        int colonPad = 10;                  // space between label end and colon
438        int valuePad = 10;                  // space between colon and value
439        int colonX = textX + maxLabelW + colonPad;
440        int valueX = colonX + fm.stringWidth(":") + valuePad;
441
442        for (int i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
443            int y = textY + i * lineSpacing;
444            g2.drawString(labels[i], textX, y);
445            g2.drawString(":", colonX, y);
446            g2.drawString(values[i], valueX, y);
447        }
448    }
449}
